title: Structure-Aware Skill Retrieval and Arbitration for Optimization Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.41909v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can turn natural-language optimization tasks into solver-checked answers, but current agents remain brittle under narrative rewrites and often store reusable experience at the instance level. We introduce \textsc{ArchOR}, an archetype-centric skill agent that builds on \textsc{OptSkills} by adding two retrieval-focused modules. \emph{Centroid-Aware Representation Learning} (CARL) refines the ordering of cached skill representations through a low-rank prototype residual. \emph{Signature-Guided Retrieval} (S\textsuperscript{3}R) attaches open-dimensional structural signatures to skills, prioritizes candidates by weighted Jaccard overlap, and bounds semantic re-ranking to a top-$K$ set. A baseline-preserving arbitration rule determines when the structural route should replace the original selector. With the same DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone and released skill library, \textsc{ArchOR} reaches 65.00\% Micro-Avg.\

translated_title: 面向优化建模的结构感知技能检索与仲裁
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够将自然语言描述的优化任务转化为经求解器验证的答案，但当前的智能体在叙述性改写下依然脆弱，且通常以实例级别存储可复用经验。我们提出了ArchOR，一个以原型为中心的技能智能体，它在OptSkills的基础上增加了两个以检索为核心的模块。质心感知表示学习（CARL）通过低秩原型残差来优化缓存技能表示的排序。签名引导检索（S³R）为技能附加开放维度的结构签名，通过加权Jaccard重叠度对候选进行优先排序，并将语义重排序限定在top-K集合内。一种保留基线的仲裁规则决定何时应由结构化路径替代原始选择器。在使用相同的DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash骨干模型和已发布的技能库的情况下，ArchOR达到了65.00%的Micro-Avg准确率。
tldr: 提出ArchOR框架，通过质心感知表示学习（CARL）和签名引导检索（S³R）两个模块实现结构感知的技能检索与仲裁，显著提升了大语言模型在优化建模任务中面对叙述改写时的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: ArchOR introduces two retrieval-focused modules—Centroid-Aware Representation Learning (CARL) and Signature-Guided Retrieval (S³R)—along with a baseline-preserving arbitration rule, enabling structure-aware skill retrieval that substantially improves the robustness of LLM-based optimization modeling against narrative rewrites.
